key_points: Baidu hit a new 52‑week low of $83.92, far below prior highs.
A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against Baidu, with a lead plaintiff deadline of Nov 13, 2026.
The lawsuit alleges securities law violations, raising potential legal and financial risk.
Baidu underperformed the broader market on Oct 7, indicating negative sentiment.
No earnings or product news; price pressure appears driven by technical/legal factors.
